text: Claude can only do what its harness allows.
Permissions are the rules you set about what Claude may read, change, or send.
We apply the principle of least access—just like giving a colleague keys only to the rooms they need.

Permissions use three settings: Allow, for actions Claude can do freely, like reading project files; Ask, where Claude must stop and wait for your approval before changing files or sending messages; and Deny, which completely blocks sensitive files like passwords, personal data, and environment files.
Stricter rules always win: Deny beats Ask, and Ask beats Allow.
